# appdynamics_synthetic_api_applications (Data Source)

Lists all Synthetic API Monitoring applications in the account (account-wide, no inputs).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_synthetic_api_applications" "all" {}

output "application_ids" {
  value = { for a in data.appdynamics_synthetic_api_applications.all.applications : a.id => a.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) The Synthetic API Monitoring applications in the account (id, name only; use the singular appdynamics_synthetic_api_application data source for app_key). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

### Nested Schema for `applications`
